name: Portal Calculator
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Fayr
description: A Fabric mod that adds a /convert command to calculate Nether portal coordinates

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: A server command /convert: "convert nether x y z" turns Overworld coordinates into Nether ones (x and z divided by 8), "convert overworld x y z" the other way, and plain "convert" converts where the player stands.
